name: Jenny Fielding
description: Jenny Fielding is the Co-Founder and General Partner at Everywhere Ventures, a pre-seed fund investing globally. Prior to founding Everywhere Ventures, Jenny was the Managing Director at Techstars NYC and a prolific angel investor, backing over 130 startups. She is also the author of Venture Everywhere, a book exploring entrepreneurship worldwide.
